_finding: Until 10.11 the impostor list was overwritten every run and no registry was kept, so no history of either existed (docs/stocks-truth-layer-tz.md §H). The archive is only worth anything if it never rewrites a row, never passes a backfilled fact off as observed, never drops a case the issuer listed and never closes a case on a partial list.

mutations.name: the archive rewrites its file instead of appending
mutations.expect: FAIL earlier rows are never rewritten: the old file only grows

mutations.name: a listed case is dropped silently
mutations.find:
if (registry.has(a)) out.push({ ...base('listed', 'observed'), ...caseFields(prev), flagged_at: prev.flagged_at ?? null })
    else if (complete)
mutations.expect: FAIL a case the issuer then listed closes as listed, never silently

mutations.name: backfilled cases are written as observed
mutations.expect: FAIL the first archive of a chain is backfilled, never passed off as seen live

mutations.name: a partial list closes cases
mutations.expect: FAIL a torn day file closes nothing: a token missing from a partial list has not left it

mutations.name: prices enter the registry snapshot
mutations.replace: paused: Array.isArray(r.paused) ? r.paused.slice().sort() : [], price: r.reference && r.reference.price_usd }))
mutations.expect: FAIL the canonical list leaves prices out, so they never make a snapshot
